array_ordering.excluded_pending_revision_ids: lexical original held raw revision ID

blank_source_policy: Keep original blank value exactly. No fabricated source-transaction revision. Require line-specific historical/manual/reversal acceptance proof plus independently captured evaluated committed flag.
clock_semantics: New artifact published_at and accepted_at are frozen producer creation/validation inputs, not backdated Books acceptance. Retain historical source clocks separately; unknown predecessor or source clock is not a known null/zero.
excluded_observations: Manifest maps each unchanged excluded raw revision to its original event. Every unit is checked against both held raw revision and held event sets, including blank-source lines.
field_presence: All 39 fields required; reject missing or extra fields. Preserve null, empty string, original numeric/string/bool types and formula strings without evaluating or normalizing them.
line_identity: Unique original native line_id within authoritative book; duplicate or changed identity bytes reject.
manifest_binding: One owner_only accepted_books source reference evidence_id hbprov1:<SHA256(canonical provenance index)> is required whenever hbjr1 units occur. The importer resolves and validates a closed private package; adjacent files or arbitrary URLs are not evidence resolution.
native_snapshot_current_gap: All 8022 frozen committed_flag literals are formulas. Pinned native/tables/replay/provenance files do not contain evaluated committed booleans or effectiveValue fields. Run membership alone is not presented as native evaluated proof.
publication_id: hbap1:<sha256(canonical envelope excluding publication_id and content_sha256)>; recompute normal content_sha256 after inserting publication_id.
transition_rule: Exact immutable replay; retain all prior accepted units and native line identities. Reject dropped or changed historical unit/line unless a future explicitly reviewed transition contract authorizes it. No such override exists in v1.
unit_canonicalization: Use pinned AdministrateMe publication.canonical_bytes: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, UTF-8.
